jobs.description:
Job description 

As our new Distribution Driver, you will deliver goods on euro-pallets to clients within your region. No heavy lifting required—you’ll be using an electric pallet jack!

    
• 
        
Hours: Full-time, averaging 10 hours per day.

    
    
• 
        
Schedule: Monday to Friday (weekends off).

    
    
• 
        
Stops: 15 to 25 customer deliveries per day.

    
    
• 
        
Start time: 07:00 AM.

    
    
• 
        
Region: Mainly West Flanders, with occasional trips to East Flanders and Wallonia.

    

 

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid Category C driving license.

    
    
• 
        
Based near Gullegem.

    
    
• 
        
Experience in distribution is a major plus.

    
    
• 
        
Flexible enough to occasionally drive a delivery van.

    
    
• 
        
Independent, proactive, safety-conscious, and customer-friendly.

    
    
• 
        
Fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.What will you be doing at Agristo?As a logistics operator, you are responsible for: 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Assistant Housekeeping Manager (m/f/x)Job DescriptionYour Focus: The well-being of guests and employees. You will assist with the coordination and management of the Housekeeping department.In addition, you will be responsible for:- Sharing responsibility for ordering and deliveries within the Housekeeping department- Collaborating with internal and external cleaning staff- Ensuring and implementing Motel One’s housekeeping standards, as well as being responsible for cleanliness in all areas- Sharing responsibility for conducting internal coaching sessions, cross-training, and onboarding new housekeeping employees- Gaining cross-departmental insights into new areas of work through collaboration in our multicultural teamsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you’re a seasoned hotel professional or looking to change careers—you’re a great fit for us! That’s because personality and hospitality skills are our top priorities! You also stand out because of:- Training in the hotel industry or professional experience in the hotel, restaurant, or retail sectors, or an interest in changing careers.- A passion for developing employees—ideally with some initial leadership experience- A strong focus on quality and service, as well as hospitality skills and a passion for the hotel industry- An open, communicative demeanor, good manners, and strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English.The ability to work well in a team and a willingness to provide cross-departmental support—we achieve our success together.

F&B ManagerJob DescriptionAs the F&B Manager at The Cloud One Hotels, you are entrusted with overseeing all F&B outlets. Alongside your team, you'll delight our guests with our locally sourced organic breakfast or the nightly "Sounds in the Clouds," featuring captivating beats at our bar. Your key responsibilities include:- Orchestrating, coordinating, and supervising operational workflows across our F&B outlets- Leadership and development of the F&B team, including recruitment, onboarding, skill enhancement, and ongoing educational initiatives- Collaborating on event planning and execution alongside our Guest Service Agent Events- Achieving revenue goals while managing cost budgets- Upholding hygiene standards and maintaining cleanliness in our F&B spaces- Building and managing relationships with local suppliers, in line with the Motel One Group's central procurement- Participation in the conception and design of our F&B offers- Enforcing workplace cleanliness and compliance with hygiene regulations- Collaborating seamlessly across departments and brandsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you're a professional in the hotel industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

• 
Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

• 
Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.
